# User — Overview
{: .no_toc }

One user's account state and administrative actions.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `USR-03` |
| **Route** | `/admin/users/:userId` · deep link `substratal://admin/users/:userId` |
| **Where** | Administration › Users |
| **Who can use it** | users.list (read), users.manage (write) |
| **Kind** | detail |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Content pane; `AdwViewSwitcher`; header-bar actions |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Header | avatar, display name, email, id-chip, StatusBadge | User + Profile |  | GtkLabel .monospace + copy |
| Tabs | tabs | Overview · Access · Roles · Sessions · Notifications · Activity | Activity = AUD-01 filtered target_user_id; Notifications = NTF-05 | AdwViewSwitcher / AdwInlineViewSwitcher |
| Facts | key-value list | email_verified, pending_email, mfa_enabled, plan, plan_sources, created_at, last_login_at, signup_application_id, test_mode, expires_at (test-mode Users only: "Expires in 3 h" / "Expired") | plan_sources link to the org or to BIL-01 subscription view (billing.manage) | AdwActionRow subtitle |
| Actions | toolbar/menu |  | Suspend (USR-05) · Reactivate · Resend invitation · Reset two-factor · Export data · Delete · Restore · Cancel scheduled erasure | GtkMenuButton |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Reactivate / Restore | `PATCH /users/{id} {status:active} (If-Match)` |  |
| Resend invitation | `POST /users/{id}/invitation` | 202 toast; 409 → not in invited state |
| Reset two-factor | `DELETE /users/{id}/mfa/totp` | confirm |
| Export | `GET /users/{id}/export` | save file |
| Delete | `DELETE /users/{id}` | confirm |
| Cancel erasure | `DELETE /users/{id}/erasure-requests/current` | visible during 7-day window |
| Extend (test-mode) | `PATCH /users/{id} {expires_at} (If-Match)` | users.manage; at least 15 min from now, at most 30 days after created_at (422 `expires_at_out_of_range`). Extending an expired User brings them back. |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/{id}` · `GET /users/{id}/profile` · `GET /users/{id}/subscription (billing.manage only)`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
